result.explanation: Use a recency-ordered entry list. Expired entries are removed before each event and immediately after time advances. Oversized puts are no-ops; other puts replace, evict oldest entries as needed, and ttl=0 removes the key.
result.mapping: Cache state maps now plus oldest-to-newest entries to key, value, size, and expiry. Output reports the current value result, recency keys, total bytes, and time.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated schema and safe-integer limits. State is only the JSON returned by this function.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let s={now:0,e:[]},cap=input.config.capacity;function clean(){s.e=s.e.filter(x=>x.x>s.now)}function rem(k){let i=s.e.findIndex(x=>x.k===k);if(i>=0)s.e.splice(i,1)}function snap(v){return {value:v,keys:s.e.map(x=>x.k),bytes:s.e.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.z,0),now:s.now}}for(let i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){let q=input.events[i],v=null;clean();if(q.type==='advance'){s.now+=q.dt;clean()}else if(q.type==='get'){let j=s.e.findIndex(x=>x.k===q.key);if(j>=0){let x=s.e.splice(j,1)[0];v=x.v;s.e.push(x)}}else if(q.type==='put'&&q.size<=cap){rem(q.key);if(q.ttl>0){let b=s.e.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.z,0);while(s.e.length&&b+q.size>cap)b-=s.e.shift().z;s.e.push({k:q.key,v:q.value,z:q.size,x:s.now+q.ttl})}}let r=snap(v),o=output[i];if(JSON.stringify(r)!==JSON.stringify(o))return false}return true}
